observations: No new photos were provided after the seller reply.
The original photos still show a light-colored 2 seater couch with rounded arms/back; no obvious large tears, but only limited angles and lighting.

claims.claim: Very neat 2 seater couch for sale
claims.evidence: Seller text only; photos show generally good condition but limited views and visible light scuffs/marks.
No receipt/date or tag visible in photos; seller did not provide proof.

claims.claim: no stain, no tear, foam still firm
claims.evidence: Seller claims testing; however, no close-up upholstery/stain check or sit/press proof video was provided.
Photos cannot confirm smoke exposure/odor; seller did not provide odor/cleaning proof.

risks.risk: Hidden stains/odor not visible in the two photos (especially on seams, underside, and creases)
risks.proof: Ask for a short video pan of the entire couch (seat, back, both arms, seams) plus a quick smell/odor check in the same video.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with possible minor stains/odor (worst case for cleaning).

risks.risk: Foam may still sag or be uncomfortable even if no tear is visible
risks.proof: Ask for a sit test video (someone sitting for 10–20 seconds and then standing to show rebound).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully firm/some sagging.

risks.risk: Small tears/loose stitching/piping wear at edges not captured by the angles
risks.proof: Ask for close-ups of all edges/piping and the underside corners (4 sides).
risks.if_unproven: Price as may need minor repair/cleaning.

risks.risk: Material type (fabric vs faux leather) and cleaning difficulty affects value
risks.proof: Ask for a close-up of the upholstery texture and any care/brand label/tag.
risks.if_unproven: Price conservatively as generic used upholstery.

proof_requests: Please send a video of you pressing/sitting on the couch (show rebound) to confirm foam firmness.
Send close-up photos/videos of: (1) all seams, (2) both armrests, (3) the full seat surface, (4) edges/piping, and (5) underside corners.
Send a photo of any brand/care label or receipt to support 'bought new last year'.
If possible, show a quick wipe/cleaning test on a small area to demonstrate no hidden stains.
response.reason: The seller’s reply is not supported by new evidence. Without additional photos/videos (especially sit/press firmness and full upholstery close-ups), the key value claims (no stains/tears and firm foam) remain unverified, so pricing confidently isn’t possible.
